name: MAHSING
recent: Mah Sing 近期在柔佛 Kulai 与 KLK Land 合作推出 RM22 亿工业园，首阶段取得 90% 认购率；同时完成 RM3 亿伊斯兰债券发行。公司也宣布以 RM2.735 亿收购 Semenyih 275 英亩土地，并延长相关条件期限。
notable: 与 KLK Land 在柔佛 Kulai 推出 RM22 亿工业园，首阶段取得 90% 认购率。
完成 RM3 亿伊斯兰债券发行。
risks: Semenyih 土地收购的延长条件期限已进一步延至 2026 年 12 月 2 日。
Kulai 土地收购的剩余先决条件期限已延长至 2026 年 12 月 21 日。
公司涉及重大诉讼（2026 年 8 月 21 日公告）。
earnings: 2026 年第二季营收为 MYR 656.3 百万，按季增长 16.5%，按年增长 16.0%；净利为 MYR 72.5 百万，按季增长 6.5%，按年增长 9.8%；净利率为 11.0%，低于上一季的 12.1%。

recent_en: Mah Sing recently launched a RM2.2 billion industrial park in Kulai, Johor with KLK Land, achieving 90% take-up for Phase 1A, and completed a RM300 million sukuk issuance. The company also announced a RM273.5 million acquisition of 275 acres in Semenyih and extended the related conditional period.
notable_en: Launched a RM2.2 billion industrial park in Kulai, Johor with KLK Land, with 90% take-up for Phase 1A.
Completed a RM300 million sukuk issuance.
Proposed acquisition of 275 acres of freehold land in Semenyih for RM273.5 million.
risks_en: The extended conditional period for the Semenyih land acquisition has been further extended to 2 December 2026.
The deadline for fulfilling remaining conditions precedent for the Kulai land acquisition has been extended to 21 December 2026.
The company is involved in material litigation (announced on 21 August 2026).
earnings_en: 2Q2026 revenue was MYR 656.3 million, up 16.5% QoQ and 16.0% YoY; net income was MYR 72.5 million, up 6.5% QoQ and 9.8% YoY; net margin was 11.0%, down from 12.1% in the previous quarter.
